knowledge.markdown:
# Knowledge Base: Riemann Hypothesis

## The Problem

> All non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function ζ(s) have real part equal to 1/2.

## What We've Built (as of 2026-02-11)

### RiemannHypothesis.lean (~770 lines)
- Formal statement of RH using Mathlib's `riemannZeta`
- PNT-strength non-vanishing: ζ(s)≠0 for Re(s)≥1 (PROVEN from Mathlib)
- Zeros symmetric under s↦1-s (PROVEN via functional equation)
- Conjugate symmetry: ζ(s)=0 ⟹ ζ(conj(s))=0 (from axiom)
- RH ↔ checking upper half-plane only (PROVEN)
- Equivalent formulations: Robin's inequality, Mertens bound, prime counting
- GRH for Dirichlet L-functions (formalized)
- **GRH implies RH (PROVEN via LFunction_modOne_eq)**

### RiemannHypothesisConsequences.lean (~632 lines)
- Mertens function with computed values up to 100
- Chebyshev θ(x) and ψ(x) functions
- Von Mangoldt function verifications
- Zeta special values: ζ(2), ζ(4), ζ(-1), ζ(-3)
- Li's criterion, zero counting formula

### Mathlib Status (2026-02-11)

| Component | Status | Notes |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| Riemann zeta ζ(s) | ✅ | Full definition with analytic continuation |
| Functional equation | ✅ | completedRiemannZeta_one_sub |
| Non-vanishing Re(s)≥1 | ✅ | riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re (PNT) |
| Euler product | ✅ | riemannZeta_eulerProduct_tprod |
| Special values | ✅ | ζ(2), ζ(4), ζ(-k) via Bernoulli |
| Dirichlet L-functions | ✅ | DirichletCharacter.LFunction |
| L → ζ bridge | ✅ | LFunction_modOne_eq (DirichletContinuation) |
| L-function non-vanishing | ✅ | LFunction_ne_zero_of_one_le_re |
| Conjugation symmetry | ❌ | Not in Mathlib (axiomatized here) |
| PNT asymptotic | ❌ | Only non-vanishing, not π(x)~x/log(x) |

## Remaining Sorries (1)
- `zero_in_strip_of_zero` (Re(s)>0 direction) - needs zero classification for Re(s)≤0

## Key References
- Riemann (1859), Edwards (1974), Conrey (2003), Bombieri (2000)
- PrimeNumberTheoremAnd: github.com/AlexKontorovich/PrimeNumberTheoremAnd
- Loeffler & Stoll (2025): Formalizing zeta and L-functions in Lean (arXiv:2503.00959)
